ruleset.name: Aurora
ruleset.description: Historical checks without a scope-equivalent built-in replacement.

rule.name: AbstractNaming
rule.message: Abstract classes must use the Abstract prefix, and concrete classes must not.
rule.description: Preserves the PMD 5.5.3 check with PMD 7 AST nodes.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //ClassDeclaration[(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'abstract' and @Interface = false() and not(starts-with(@SimpleName, 'Abstract'))) or (not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'abstract') and starts-with(@SimpleName, 'Abstract'))]

rule.name: ReturnEmptyArrayRatherThanNull
rule.message: Return an empty array rather than null.
rule.description: Preserves the PMD 5.5.3 check with PMD 7 AST nodes.

rule.name: ClassWithOnlyPrivateConstructorsShouldBeFinal
rule.message: A class which only has private constructors should be final
rule.description: Preserves PMD 5.5.3's single top-level type, explicit constructor and no nested class scope.
